definition: Slab material and charge genealogy; no upstream operation timestamps in this subset
encoding_detail: Actual milestone columns on the existing business object; NULL means not yet occurred. Authored added event columns: slab_received_at, slab_identity_verified_at, slab_quality_checked_at, slab_released_for_rolling_at.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE slab_material (slab_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, charge_id TEXT NOT NULL, slab_received_at TEXT, slab_identity_verified_at TEXT, slab_quality_checked_at TEXT, slab_released_for_rolling_at TEXT)

definition: Scheduled rolling instruction; plan times do not prove execution
encoding_detail: Actual milestone columns on the existing business object; NULL means not yet occurred. Authored added event columns: rolling_plan_created_at, rolling_plan_reviewed_at, rolling_plan_approved_at, rolling_plan_released_at.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE planned_rolling_instruction (plan_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slab_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES slab_material(slab_id), planned_reheat_at TEXT NOT NULL, rolling_plan_created_at TEXT, rolling_plan_reviewed_at TEXT, rolling_plan_approved_at TEXT, rolling_plan_released_at TEXT)

definition: Released rolling work instruction, separate from planning
encoding_detail: Actual milestone columns on the existing business object; NULL means not yet occurred. Authored added event columns: rolling_instruction_acknowledged_at, rolling_setup_verified_at, rolling_work_started_at, rolling_instruction_closed_at.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE rolling_instruction (instruction_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, plan_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES planned_rolling_instruction(plan_id), released_at TEXT NOT NULL, rolling_instruction_acknowledged_at TEXT, rolling_setup_verified_at TEXT, rolling_work_started_at TEXT, rolling_instruction_closed_at TEXT)

definition: As-rolled mother material with milestone columns and latest-operation snapshot
encoding_detail: One material object row contains two different extracted business milestones. Extracted event columns: furnace_charged_at, crop_shear_passed_at.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE as_rolled_material (material_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, as_rolled_plate_no TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, slab_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES slab_material(slab_id), instruction_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES rolling_instruction(instruction_id), furnace_charged_at TEXT , crop_shear_passed_at TEXT , latest_operation_completed_at TEXT , created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

definition: Furnace charge tracking record separated from material lifecycle snapshot
encoding_detail: Actual milestone columns on the existing business object; NULL means not yet occurred. Authored added event columns: furnace_charge_assigned_at, furnace_charge_confirmed_at, furnace_discharge_confirmed_at.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE furnace_charge_tracking (tracking_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, material_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES as_rolled_material(material_id), yard_instruction_received_at TEXT NOT NULL, lot_charging_started_at TEXT NOT NULL, furnace_charge_assigned_at TEXT, furnace_charge_confirmed_at TEXT, furnace_discharge_confirmed_at TEXT)

definition: Cutting/finishing work instruction for mother material
encoding_detail: Actual milestone columns on the existing business object; NULL means not yet occurred. Authored added event columns: cutting_instruction_acknowledged_at, cutting_setup_verified_at, cutting_work_started_at, cutting_instruction_closed_at.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE cutting_finishing_instruction (instruction_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, material_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES as_rolled_material(material_id), released_at TEXT NOT NULL, cut_method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(cut_method='SPLIT'), cutting_instruction_acknowledged_at TEXT, cutting_setup_verified_at TEXT, cutting_work_started_at TEXT, cutting_instruction_closed_at TEXT)

definition: Individual cut Plate material, distinct from mother as-rolled material
encoding_detail: Actual milestone columns on the existing business object; NULL means not yet occurred. Authored added event columns: plate_piece_identified_at, plate_quality_released_at, plate_packed_at.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE plate_material (plate_material_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, plate_no TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, parent_as_rolled_plate_no TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES as_rolled_material(as_rolled_plate_no), dimension_inspected_at TEXT , latest_operation_completed_at TEXT , plate_piece_identified_at TEXT, plate_quality_released_at TEXT, plate_packed_at TEXT)

definition: Synthetic operation process-code meanings; codes are newly authored
encoding_detail: Master, plan, reference or relationship/index data; this table does not directly produce an event in the current ES. Related objects can still have logs from other tables.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE operation_code (code TEXT PRIMARY KEY, meaning TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

definition: Immutable operation history for mother and piece material identities
encoding_detail: operation_code selects the action; one completed operation per history row. started_at is not currently extracted as a second event.
origin: Source-based table; adaptations documented in design/source_mapping.json
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE material_operation_history (transaction_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, material_id TEXT NOT NULL, operation_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operation_code(code), started_at TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(completed_at > started_at), created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
